items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: Willie Lynch and Chick Webb both knew me and had heard of me. They both tried to hire me.

ctx.x: With Louis Russell. in one band, and Willie Lynch, on the other band. The bass player that was playing with Louis their Russell during intermission, he got up and (left) Louis Russell.
and there instead where the orchestra was. Russell sent for me to come ... He asked me would I play, and I did. I played the next night.
